global: A vibrant top-down view of a ramen bowl on a wooden table. The rich tonkotsu broth, chashu pork, and fresh ingredients create a warm, hearty meal.

regions.background: Wooden table with natural grain and slight wear
regions.bowl: Ramen bowl with a smooth, white ceramic surface and slight rim curvature
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, golden, and slightly foamy
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed is dark green, thin, and curled at the edges
regions.meat: Chashu pork is tender, pink, and slightly fatty with a marbled texture
regions.menma: Bamboo shoots are pale, crisp, and segmented with a slight sheen
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake is round, slightly translucent, and has a soft, golden crust
